objective: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill Sin'Dall and return with her paw.

description: Here is the final challenge that I will put forth.  We've been tracking an elusive tiger for weeks.  We call the beast Sin'Dall.  See if you can do what no <race> has done before: hunt down and kill Sin'Dall.  Bring me her paw as proof of your accomplishment.
Tracking her down will be no easy task.
progress: How goes the hunt for Sin'Dall?
completion: Most impressive, I do say!  You are a true Master Tiger Hunter, <name>!
